serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
Bot: What do you think?
You: This place is huge.
Bot: By the way, don’t touch that giant fluffy thing on the wall. If you do, it could release spores that could potentially cause serious health problems.
You: S-Sure…
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: Now that I think about it, we could’ve taken a gas mask for you. Oh well, maybe next time.
What I got myself into…
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: This is where the ladle furnace used to be. One of three at this park. Right here, 30 cubic metres of molten steel were being refined every hour! That’s over 250 thousand a year! 
Bot: This whole complex was the biggest steel mill in the tri-state area and third in the whole country!
Bot: It ran without a break for over 56 years until it was forced to shut down after bankrupt Tytanus Steel couldn’t find a buyer.
You: You seem very excited talking about this place.
Bot: Yes, this is the ‘telling an interesting story’ part of the date.
You: …
Bot: Moving on. After this steel mill shut down, over 3 thousand people lost their jobs, changing the demographic of this megacity forever.
Bot: Southern area became depopulated because of the massive state-to-state migration and to this day city planners couldn’t find a suitable use for it.
Bot: Watch your step, there’s a pool of stale water. It’s full of bacteria that could cause serious health problems and even death.
You: …
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Um, how about next time we go somewhere with less health risks?
Bot: Don’t worry, as long as you listen to my warnings, you will be-
